name: Vansen LumiStride Jogger
description: A tapered jogger in charcoal with a single wide transparent biopolymer panel running down each outer thigh — designed for bioluminescent geneware users who want to move freely without hiding their mods. The rest of the fabric is a soft four-way stretch. Elastic cuffs, hidden waistband drawstring. Popular with people who run or cycle, and with people who just like the look.
functionality: Outer thigh transparent panels display bioluminescent geneware during movement; four-way stretch for full range of motion
what_it_says: You're active, you've got bioluminescence, and you've stopped dressing like you need to apologize for it.
story_hooks: At night the transparent panels turn the wearer into an inadvertent beacon — useful or dangerous depending on who's watching.
A character's panels are cracked down the center of one leg, dimming the glow on that side — they haven't had it fixed yet.
